scenarios.title: PUT replaces book fields
scenarios.given: Book id 1 exists with title 'Dune' in memory.
scenarios.when: PUT /books/1 with JSON {'title': 'Dune 2', 'author': 'Frank Herbert Jr', 'isbn': '978-0441172720', 'synopsis': 'Updated synopsis'}
scenarios.then: Response is 200 with JSON containing title 'Dune 2', author 'Frank Herbert Jr', isbn '978-0441172720', synopsis 'Updated synopsis'

scenarios.title: PUT rejects non-integer path id
scenarios.given: Book store starts empty in memory.

scenarios.title: GET returns 404 for nonexistent book
scenarios.given: Book store has books but not id 999.

scenarios.title: DELETE returns 404 for nonexistent book
scenarios.given: Book store has books but not id 999.

logic: BookHandler extends http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler with do_GET, do_PUT, do_DELETE methods and a reference to the BookStore from T1.
BookStore holds dict {id: Book} and integer next_id under a threading.Lock for thread safety; book fields are id, title, author, isbn, synopsis.
do_GET parses path id from /books/{id}; non-integer id returns 400 with JSON {'error': '<message>'}.
do_GET looks up id in BookStore; missing id returns 404 with JSON {'error': '<message>'}; found returns 200 with the book as JSON.
do_PUT parses path id; non-integer id returns 400 with JSON {'error': '<message>'}.
do_PUT validates request body per T2 rules (reject id in body, missing/empty/wrong-type fields) returning 400 with JSON {'error': '<message>'}.
do_PUT looks up id; missing id returns 404 with JSON {'error': '<message>'}; found replaces title, author, isbn, synopsis, keeps id, stores, returns 200 with updated book as JSON.
do_DELETE parses path id; non-integer id returns 400; missing id returns 404 with JSON {'error': '<message>'}; otherwise removes the book and responds 204 with no body.
All JSON responses set Content-Type: application/json; DELETE 204 sets no body.
